text:
Maria (CS): FYI customer Acme reported large rerank score changes after last night's model update. Same query + candidates, top result flipped. They're seeing production deltas up to 0.6 score points.
Anya (Support): Oof. Do we know which model/version their route pinned to? Any errors in the API call?
Maria (CS): They're calling /v1/rerank (customer route: acme-prod). No 4xx/5xx. Just different scores. Payload size small. Sample payload I asked them for:
```json
{"query":"best wireless headphones","candidates":["Brand X model A","Brand Y model B","Brand Z model C"]}
```
Old (pre-deploy) scores returned by our rerank endpoint: `[0.92, 0.58, 0.33]`
New (post-deploy) scores: `[0.34, 0.84, 0.29]`
Anya (Support): Logged ticket #CS-7829 and shared the payload + response. Customer says this affects sorting in their feed. They can reproduce on a small set of queries.
deploy-bot: Deploy finished: redwood-rerank-v3-quantized @ 2026-11-07T02:12:00Z — rollout=100% :rocket:
Eli (ML): Thanks — that deploy was the quantization/FP16->int8 patch (PR #3456). Quantization can change logits ordering in edge cases. Need to confirm if this is quant-only or something else.
Andrew (Eng): Can you repro locally with the same model binary? If quantization math is causing it, running both float16 and quantized on the exact inputs should show differences in logits. Also check tokenizer version.
Jamal (SRE): I pulled logs for acme-prod around the timeframe — no 5xx, latency normal. No rate-limit triggered.
Anya (Support): Customer gave us a small eval set (120 queries). I've uploaded to /shared/cs/CS-7829/eval_set.csv and attached their example rows.
Eli (ML): I'll run a differential eval: compare logits, tokenization outputs, and softmax scores between redwood-rerank-v3 (fp16) and redwood-rerank-v3-quantized. Hypothesis: int8 quant introduced rounding that flips pairwise ranking for close candidates.
Andrew (Eng): Also check batching/ordering — we changed kernel selection for small batches in the runtime patch. If KV cache or continuous batching path differs for rerank requests, that could change numerical ordering.
Eli (ML): Good call — I'll disable batching in the local run to rule that out.
Jamal (SRE): For traceability, can we get request_id samples from the customer? That helps map to runtime path.
Maria (CS): Customer sent request_id samples in ticket. I added them to the ticket thread.
infra-bot: Canary metrics: redwood-rerank-v3-quantized - RTT +2ms, p95 unchanged, no increased error rate.
Eli (ML): Early findings after 120 queries: 18 queries show rank flips between float16 and quantized. The largest flips correlate with candidates whose logits are within ~0.05 of each other. Tokenization differences: none.
Andrew (Eng): If quantized model is the culprit we should consider fast rollback on the dedicated fleet for accounts with SLA until we have a mitigation (re-quantize with calibration tweak or use fp16 fallback).
Anya (Support): Customer asked for ETA on rollback. Can we provide a short-term mitigation (route them to float model) while ML investigates?
Jamal (SRE): We can add a route override for acme-prod to pin to redwood-rerank-v3 (fp16) immediately. I can push that change and monitor.
Eli (ML): Action plan: 1) run full diff on 10k eval to quantify prevalence 2) run per-layer calibration sweeps for int8 3) produce a patch with improved calibration or fall back to fp16 for rank-critical routes. I'll own ML tasks.
Andrew (Eng): I'll prepare an ops rollback playbook and help Jamal apply route override if customer requests it.
Anya (Support): I'll update the customer with plan and offer immediate route pin while we triage.
Maria (CS): Thanks team. Please add any logs or diffs to the ticket. Marking owners: Eli (ML) owns investigation, Jamal (SRE) owns route change, Andrew (Eng) supports runtime checks, Anya (Support) is customer comms.
Eli (ML): One more note — also evaluate whether embedding or rerank config (length normalization/scaling) changed in the release config; sometimes scaling params can exacerbate quant noise.
Jamal (SRE): I'll schedule a quick on-call window if we need to rollback tonight.
Anya (Support): Customer acknowledged and prefers immediate pin if possible. I'll wait for Jamal's confirm. :thumbsup:
Maria (CS): Closing loop here once rollback/pin done and ML posts diff summary. Thanks all.
